description: Detect suspicious DNS queries with high query rates and multiple subdomains

steps.explanation: Filter events from the DNS index with the correct sourcetype
Extract the top-level domain (TLD) from the query
Focus on queries with known suspicious TLDs
Extract the subdomain (SLD) from the query
Sort events by time to ensure temporal order

steps.params: count as qps, dc(sld) as sld_cnt, values(sld) as sld_set
steps.explanation: Calculate query rate and analyze subdomain patterns
Group results by host and time period
Identify hosts with high query rates and multiple subdomains
